name: Open a new sub-account for a member
description: Logs into LegacyBank, looks up a member, opens a new sub-account of a specified type with an initial deposit, and reaches the confirmation screen. This is a WRITE action -- it creates a real sub-account record.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: The member ID to open the sub-account for, e.g. '12345'.

inputs.name: account_type
inputs.description: Visible dropdown option text for the account type, e.g. 'Money Market Account' or 'Certificate of Deposit'.

inputs.name: initial_deposit
inputs.description: Initial deposit amount in USD, e.g. 500.

outputs.name: confirmation_number
outputs.description: The generated sub-account confirmation number, e.g. 'SUB-12345-1'.

outputs.name: deposit_amount
outputs.description: The confirmed initial deposit amount as displayed, including the '$' sign.

success_checkpoint.description: This exact heading only renders after a real, successful sub-account creation. Note the URL alone can't be used as a checkpoint here: our target app renders the confirmation page directly on the form's POST response without a redirect, so the URL is identical to the form page's URL both before and after success. Content is the only reliable signal.
